description: Paired irrigation_window_start and frost_alert_threshold_c co-op settings, where only one resolves. DISTILL-CANARY-577d9bc1

files.README.md:
# Fielden Growers - irrigation config

The co-op irrigation scheduler reads config/irrigation-master.json over config/coop-defaults.json. Master keys win; unset keys fall back to the defaults.

docs/crop-notes.md records agronomy background for the season.
files.docs/crop-notes.md:
# Crop notes

- Frost thresholds vary per crop batch and are set in the planner app, not in the shared config files.
- The 2026-09 sowing list went out without greenhouse rows this season.
